description: This file defines a PHP class ReportingMethodSearchFilterParams that extends FilterParams, used for specifying filtering parameters related to reporting methods within the OrangeHRM PIM plugin. It primarily sets a default sort field for filtering reporting methods.

classes.name: ReportingMethodSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A class extending FilterParams used to define filtering parameters for reporting methods, with a default sort field set to 'rm.name'.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object and sets the default sort field to 'rm.name'.
